description: The conversation between the guest and the host about a booking, oldest first (including the guest's note with the request and the host's note when accepting or declining). Use it to relay the host's replies. Pass guest_email (the email the booking was made with) unless you connect with an agent token.

booking_id.description: The booking's id, from request_booking (starts with bkg_).

guest_email.description: The email the booking was made with. Needed unless you connect with an agent token.

name: get_messages

outputSchema.description: The conversation with the host, oldest first.

title: Read messages with the host
